evidence_quote: stores, rotates, and controls access to privileged credentials
notes: Password Safe is BeyondTrust's primary vault; supports automated rotation on check-in or schedule; NIST-based password generation; SSH key management included.

evidence_quote: securely manages and controls remote access to critical systems
notes: PRA provides full session proxy/isolation via Jump technology; no direct credential exposure to client; supports RDP/SSH/web-app proxying; Kubernetes proxy added in v25.2.

evidence_quote: real-time session monitoring, auditing, and recording
notes: Full RDP/SSH/shell session recording; Session Forensics enables searchable shell recordings; keystroke-level audit trail; available in both Password Safe and PRA.

evidence_quote: Elevated permissions provided only when needed, for minimum duration
notes: JIT via EPM-WM (JIT Application Access + JIT Admin Access), Password Safe JIT access control, and Entitle JIT for cloud; ZSP model supported; time-bound access with automatic revocation.

evidence_quote: discovers assets, such as systems, databases, applications, or network devices
notes: BeyondInsight Discovery Scanner finds privileged accounts including SSH keys
column14: and remote access tools. Free standalone discovery tool available.

evidence_quote: identifying, controlling, and securely storing application credentials
notes: Password Safe API + Secrets Safe covers AAPM; DevOps Secrets Safe serves CI/CD workloads; Secrets Cache ensures local caching for high-performance throughput. No native SPIFFE/SVID workload attestation.

evidence_quote: multi-factor, smart card, and third-party authentication
notes: Per-session MFA enforced at each privileged session start (PRA); SAML 2.0 federation; RADIUS/LDAP/smart card support; Azure MFA integration for Password Safe.

evidence_quote: give you access to your critical systems in emergencies
notes: Dedicated break-glass design guidance and whitepaper; Secrets Cache serves last-known-good credentials during Password Safe outages; cloud DR with geo-redundant storage supports offline/DR retrieval.

evidence_quote: Removes excessive admin rights while providing controlled, secure access
notes: Core BeyondTrust differentiator. EPM-WM covers Windows/Mac; EPM-Linux covers Unix/Linux. Application control, privilege elevation rules, and audit. Formerly PowerBroker/Avecto — deep market history.

evidence_quote: enforce least privilege across all human/non-human identities and accounts
notes: Layered least-privilege approach: EPM removes local admin rights, Password Safe eliminates standing credentials, Entitle right-sizes cloud entitlements; Identity Security Insights surfaces over-privileged accounts.

evidence_quote: manage and control remote access for third-party vendors
notes: PRA is explicitly positioned for VPAM (vendor privileged access management). VPN-free; brokered access via single pathway; granular session controls; no agent required on vendor device; audit logging.

evidence_quote: discovers, analyzes, and controls permissions across AWS, Azure, and GCP
notes: Entitle (acquired 2024) provides CIEM: cloud entitlement discovery, JIT cloud access, and least-privilege right-sizing across major clouds. Recognized as GigaOm 2026 CIEM Leader & Outperformer. Maturing rapidly post-acquisition; deeper PAM+CIEM integration still in progress.

evidence_quote: assigns unique identities to machines, applications, services, containers
notes: DevOps Secrets Safe assigns machine identities and provides secrets brokering for workloads/containers. No native SPIFFE/SVID workload attestation documented; secretless access (zero credential exposure to workload) is partial — API-pull model still requires credential at call-time. [INDUSTRY-CONSENSUS: secretless/SPIFFE is emerging PAM frontier; most PAM vendors lag]

evidence_quote: saves up to 90% of effort spent on user access reviews
notes: Entitle provides automated access review campaigns with audit-ready evidence. Access certification for cloud entitlements is strong. Native PAM-level privileged-account recertification within Password Safe/BeyondInsight is limited; Entitle fills the gap for cloud. Maturity 3 reflects partial coverage.

evidence_quote: behavioral analytics teamed with vulnerability data and security intelligence
notes: BeyondInsight Threat Analytics + PUBA: ML-based baseline profiling, risk scoring, anomaly detection across privileged sessions. Identity Security Insights adds AI-powered cross-domain identity threat analytics and attack-path visualization.

evidence_quote: anomaly-based detections use AI-backed methods to report unusual activity
notes: Identity Security Insights provides credential-theft detection with ITDR capabilities; BeyondTrust detected Okta Support breach weeks before Okta acknowledged it. KuppingerCole 2024 ITDR Overall Leader. Detects compromised accounts; can trigger automated responses (rotate, terminate session).

evidence_quote: automated backups, geo-redundant storage, and Azure availability zones
notes: Cloud SaaS uptime SLA 99.9% (consistently exceeded); transactional log backups every 5-10 min; geo-redundant storage across paired Azure regions; Secrets Cache ensures credential availability during PS outage; U-Series on-prem supports clustering and mirroring. ISO 22301-aligned BC/DR plan.
